commit.message:
feat: move treadmill templates to a cardio-template DB type

Treadmill interval templates were hardcoded frontend constants, so adding
or editing a variant required a code change and redeploy. Promote them to
a first-class `cardio-template` Cosmos document type (userId: 'shared',
same shared-library model as exercises and workout-day-definitions).

- New default template "Walk/Jog 5x6.0 + 1x7.0" (jogs 6x6.0 then 7.0,
  38 min); the old 5x5.4+1x6.0 stays available as the second option.
- backend: public GET /api/cardio-templates + admin POST/PUT/DELETE;
  init-database seeds from seed-cardio-templates.js (idempotent).
- snapshot: new cardio_templates table so anonymous visitors get templates.
- frontend: WorkoutDrawer loads templates via useDataSource().
  cardioTemplates.js is retained only as an offline fallback (mirrors the
  seed), so the dropdown is never blank if the source is empty or errors.

Logged sessions are unaffected — they store their own interval snapshot.
